patterns: Surprise-person reveals beat trailers: the Texas attorney general who scored Dragon Ball Z hit 3.46M on DiscussingFilm, the biggest post of the day
Casting and greenlight news travels: Cynthia Erivo as Tupac's mom 2.30M, the Constantine movie 1.49M, and Maya Hawke in Magic: The Gathering 1.03M
GTA 6 screenshot drops stacked up on DiscussingFilm (532k, 404k, 356k, 274k), showing games now compete with film news on film accounts

Nostalgia lineups and franchise retrospectives win on FilmUpdates: the Hunger Games past-to-present lineup hit 1.25M, while the morning's Dune: Part Three character stills only reached 6k to 18k in their first hour
Short label captions work for CinemaTweets1: 'One of the Best Films of the 21st Century' drew 92k, about double its next-best post
ATRightMovies' trivia and question posts stay steady at 10k to 35k, with the Tom Hanks and Clint Eastwood story clip the outlier at 128k
narrative_synthesis: A surprise reveal ran the watchlist: Texas' new attorney general turned out to be a Dragon Ball Z composer (3.46M on DiscussingFilm). Casting and greenlights followed, with Cynthia Erivo as Tupac's mom at 2.30M, a Constantine movie at 1.49M and Maya Hawke in Magic: The Gathering at 1.03M. FilmUpdates' Hunger Games lineup hit 1.25M while new Dune: Part Three stills were still warming up. RealEmirHan posted no originals in the window.
